summary: Query and command a Kia vehicle directly with curl against the Kia Owners API (api.owners.kia.com), without running the MCP server. Use when the user wants a one-off read of their Kia's status, location, or EV charge state, or to lock/unlock/start climate from the shell — "check my Kia", "is the car locked", "what's the EV9 charge", "lock the car from the terminal". Requires KIA_USERNAME/KIA_PASSWORD and a one-time SMS/email MFA bootstrap.
